notes.title: Ink Demon's Eve Has Begun
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

The Ink Demon's Eve is upon the studio for a very limited time in this especially spooky Halloween overlay. Search far and wide for the skulls of the dead and return them home for a wicked surprise. Take some time to trick-or-treat throughout your candle lit adventure.. but you'll have much better luck if you can find a mask to impress the inky locals. Unlock new achievements before the Ink Demon's Eve is over... or else you'll have to wait another year for it to come again.

Patch Notes for v1.0.4

 Added 4 additional languages: Russian, Ukrainian, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese
 Updated Bendy Cutout Texture
 Fixed several typo's throughout the game
 Steam Achievements should now pop up properly
 Updated Sensitivity for both Mouse and Controller
 Updated Credits to include Co-Creator Mike Desjardins
 Added some spooky stuff for Halloween
 Added 3 Halloween dedicated achievements

Happy Halloween! Stay safe everyone!

- Bendy Team

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Updates

 Added the Archives, accessible through main menu after game completion
 Localized subtitles, menus, and prompts in French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Japanese
 Various bug fixes relating to collision and sequence breaking
 Various performance improvements have been made throughout the game
 Reduced the occurrence of the game freezing in some areas
 Reduced dead enemy body count to prevent physics issues
 Many typo corrections
 More secrets


-Mike

Edit: Whoops! Sorry about that, I just did a quick hotfix for v1.0.3.0319 to fix the accidental campus crush magenta machine!

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Options Updates

Graphics Update
Graphics:

 VSync OFF should no longer cap frame rate

Resolution Update
Graphics:

 Resolution can now be selected for 16:9 and 16:10 displays

Sensitivity Update
Controls:

 Sensitivity will now effect both mouse and controller look speed.
 Smooth Camera OFF will switch the camera movement be more responsive, but will cause some jitter in the environment while moving.

Graphics:

 VSync OFF will cause sensitivity to become unstable, and will need Smooth Camera to be turned OFF.


General Updates

 Enemy AI stuck state when hiding resolved
 Death sequences being canceled by movement resolved
 Section loading and initializing when traveling resolved
 Interaction Text displaying CANNOT FIND TERM resolved
 Interactable objects flickering when highlighting resolved
 Random respawn locations resolved
 Game resource files updated to be less bloated
 Collision updates in areas where there was no collision
 Several sequence breaking bugs resolved (sorry speed runners)
 Wandering is a terrible sin...
 Additional secrets added
